features.name: Local media library scanning and rebuilding
steps: Put several audio files with different Title, Artist, Album, Genre, and Track metadata into the device's music directory
Launch the app or run "rescan media library"
The output size at the bottom updates automatically
The song appears in the media library
The original audio files themselves must not be deleted by scanning

After deleting or adding audio on the device, rescanning should make the media library consistent with the actual files again. The intermediate state where the media library cannot be used normally should be reflected during the rescan, and internal derived data such as play history may be rebuilt/cleared according to the app's rules.
features.expected: After scanning, songs appear in the media library with counts matching the actual files; the original audio files are not deleted by scanning; after adding or deleting files the rescan content changes in sync; the intermediate state where the media library is temporarily unavailable should be reflected during scanning.

features.name: Song-library browsing and sorting
steps: Enter the "songs" page
Show all scanned songs' covers, titles, artists, and albums
Open sorting
Select the sort conditions already present in the screenshot such as "first character A-Z/Z-A, artist, album, year, added date, modified date"
The list order changes immediately
After leaving the page and returning it still displays by the app's sort state. For songs under identical conditions a stable, reasonable secondary sort should be maintained.
features.expected: Each sort condition genuinely changes the list order; after leaving and returning it still displays by the selected sort; under identical conditions a stable, reasonable secondary sort is maintained.

features.name: Album aggregation and album details
steps: Set the same/different Album for several songs
The "Albums" page should aggregate automatically by album
The card shows the album cover, album name, artist, and song count
Open an album
Show the cover, artist, song count, total duration, etc.
Below, only that album's songs are listed, keeping a reasonable order such as Track/Disc
From any of the songs you can still return to the corresponding album.
features.expected: The albums page aggregates automatically by Album metadata and the cards show the cover, name, artist, and song count; the album details list only that album's songs in Track or Disc order; the totals and duration match reality.

features.name: Artist aggregation and artist details
steps: Set up several Albums and Songs under the same Artist
The "Artists" page aggregates them into one artist
Show the album count and song count
Open the artist
The top summarizes the album count, song count, and total duration
The same page shows its album and songs respectively
Entering from a song's "view artist" gives the same data. When multiple Artist metadata values exist, navigation must follow the app's rules correctly.
features.expected: The same Artist is aggregated into one entry showing the album and song counts; the artist page's totals and total duration match reality; entering the artist from a song gives the same data.

features.name: Genre aggregation
steps: Prepare music with different genres
The "genres" page groups by genre and counts the songs
Opening a genre shows only the songs belonging to it
Operations such as play-from-here and add-to-queue still target the real song entity
If the genre is modified through tag editing, the song counts of the old and new genres should update accordingly after returning to the genres page.
features.expected: Genre grouping and song counts are correct; opening a genre shows only the songs belonging to it; after changing a song's genre the old and new genre counts update accordingly.

features.name: Folder browsing
steps: Enter "folders" from the sidebar
Browse by the real storage directory hierarchy, e.g. /storage/emulated/0/Music
The breadcrumb changes with the level
Folders and audio files are displayed separately
Audio items show the file name and size
Tapping the audio performs the default playback behavior
The correct navigation level is preserved when returning to the parent directory. Songs in the folder view should also be able to read the cover and take part in playback.
features.expected: The directory hierarchy reflects the real storage paths; the breadcrumb changes with the level; audio items show the file name and size; tapping plays them and can read the cover; the navigation level is correct when returning to the parent directory.

features.name: Subtasks display correctly under the parent task; they can be completed independently; collapsing the parent hides the subtasks and expanding restores them; after deleting or adjusting subtasks the hierarchy stays correct.
steps: Use a blacklist in the settings to hide the specified directory

After re-entering the media library / rescanning, music in that directory should not appear in the songs, albums, artists, genres, and other media library views; then use whitelist mode to restrict the start directory
Only media within the allowed scope enters the media library
The file itself stays unchanged.
features.expected: Music in blacklisted directories does not appear in any songs, albums, artists, genres, or other views; in whitelist mode only media within the allowed scope enters the media library; the files themselves stay unchanged.

features.name: Search songs and media entities
steps: Tap search
Enter the full or partial song title
Return the matching songs
Select "delete from device" on a local song and confirm
Selecting a result enters the correct entity page or song
Clearing the query restores the full results. The search must be based on the current media library data, and after adding, deleting, or modifying metadata the results change in sync.
features.expected: Entering full or partial text matches songs; entities such as Artist, Album, Genre, and Playlist are searchable; selecting a result enters the correct page; clearing the query restores the full results; after metadata changes the results change in sync.

features.name: Basic audio playback loop
steps: Tap any song from the songs page
The current playback bar shows the correct Title
Open the now-playing screen
Show the cover, Title, Artist, Album, and total duration
Tapping play/pause genuinely changes the audio state
Drag the progress bar to jump to the corresponding time
After playback ends it advances to the next song in the current queue
After returning to the media library the bottom mini-player and the full playback page stay in the same state.
features.expected: Tapping a song must genuinely play it; the playback bar and playback page show the same Title, Artist, and Album; pause, resume, and dragging the progress take real effect; after playback ends it advances to the next song in the queue; the mini-player and the full playback page stay consistent.

features.name: Previous / next / automatic continuous playback
steps: Turn Separate chroma quality on/off
Tap next during playback
The current song, cover, progress, and queue position switch at the same time
Tapping previous returns to the previous item/current track start according to the player rules
Let the song finish playing naturally
Automatically start the next song
When the queue boundary is reached it stops or continues according to the Repeat state.
features.expected: Next switches the song, cover, progress, and queue position; previous returns to the previous item or the current track's start according to the player rules; when playback ends naturally it automatically advances to the next song; the queue boundary stops or continues according to the loop state.

features.name: Shuffle and loop playback states
steps: Start playback in a collection containing several songs
After enabling shuffle the subsequent playback order is no longer simply the list order
Switch the loop state and verify that off/queue loop/single loop actually affect the behavior after a song ends
After leaving the playback page and returning the current state should not be lost without reason; when the app supports remembering playback state it should follow the setting.
features.expected: In shuffle mode the playback order is no longer the list order; the loop state genuinely affects the behavior after a song ends; leaving the playback page and returning does not lose the state; the settings persist.

features.name: "Play next" and the playback-queue insertion
steps: Song A is playing and the queue has B and C after it
Perform "add to the play queue" on several songs
The current A is not interrupted
D is inserted after the current position
When A finishes or Next is tapped, D is entered first
The existing B and C continue to keep their later positions.
features.expected: The current song is not interrupted; the inserted song sits after the current song and before the original queue; when it finishes or Next is tapped the inserted song plays first; the original queue's remaining order is unchanged.

features.name: Adding to the play queue and queue management
steps: Verify offline search on downloaded maps.
Completing, restoring, and deleting tasks
View "up next" on the now-playing page
The queue should show the correct song, index, and total
Clearing the play queue removes the following queue content
Saving the play queue can convert the current queue into a persistent playlist
The save result still exists after re-entering.
features.expected: Added songs appear in "up next" with their index and total; clearing the queue removes the following content; saving the queue produces a persistent playlist that still exists after re-entering.

features.name: Playlist creation, adding songs, and persistence
steps: Choose "add to playlist…" from the song menu
Create or choose a playlist
Add several songs in succession
Open the playlist to confirm the song set and order
From the playlist you can directly "play", "shuffle", "play next", or "add to the play queue"
After closing and reopening the app the user's playlists and their contents still exist.
features.expected: The playlist is genuinely saved and still exists after re-entering; the song set and order match what was added; from the list you can play, shuffle, play next, or add to the queue; deleting the list does not affect the original songs.

features.name: Automatic playlists / derived lists
steps: Use automatic lists such as "recently added", "play history", "not played recently", and "favorite songs"
After adding a local song the "recently added" count changes

Real merchant responses in customer service
Real-time merchant-side replies and session routing
After favoriting/unfavoriting, "favorite songs" increases or decreases in real time
These lists must not be faked with static data but computed dynamically from the song states.
features.expected: The automatic lists are computed dynamically from the song states rather than static data; after adding songs the recently-added count changes; after playing a song the history grows and "not played recently" changes; after a favorite change the favorite songs increase or decrease in real time.

features.name: Favorite the song
steps: Play a song
Tap the heart on the playback page to favorite
The favorite state changes visually
Returning to "favorite songs" finds that song
Unfavorite again
The favorites list removes that song, but the song remains in the normal song library, albums, Artists, and the file system.
features.expected: The heart favorite state toggles and persists; favorited songs appear in favorite songs; after unfavoriting they are removed from that list but the song remains in the song library, albums, artists, and the file system.

features.name: The music tag editor and the media library sync
steps: Open a song's "music tag editor"
Change the fields currently offered by the editor such as Title, Artist, Album, Album Artist, Genre, and Year/Track
Save
After returning to the media library the song shows the new title
Artist/Album/Genre aggregation reclassifies automatically
Opening "details" reads the modified information
After rescanning the media library the modifications should still come from the real file metadata rather than existing only in the app database.
features.expected: After saving, the media library shows the new tags; Artist, Album, and Genre aggregation reclassifies automatically; the details read the modified information; after rescanning the modifications still come from the real file metadata rather than only the app database.

features.name: Song details and real file information
steps: Adjust the brightness, contrast, and saturation for that point independently
The left side shows one version and the right side another
The data should match the actual files
The information changes accordingly when another audio file is loaded rather than being template text.
features.expected: The detail fields match the actual file, including the path, size, format, bitrate, sample rate, and duration; the information changes when another file is loaded; it must not be template text.

features.name: Delete the song from the device
steps: Adjust the gain for songs with ReplayGain metadata according to the selected Track/Album mode; after disabling it the normal playback gain is restored. Switching the setting during playback should not break the queue or playback progress.
The real audio file is deleted
The song disappears from the songs page
The counts of the album/artist/genre it belongs to are recomputed
Media library and UI configuration persistence
It must not reappear even after rescanning; other song files are unaffected.
features.expected: The real audio file is deleted; the song disappears from the songs page; the album, artist, and genre counts are recomputed; the queue is removed in sync; rescanning no longer shows it; other song files are unaffected.

features.name: Sleep timer
steps: Music is playing
Open the "sleep timer"
Set the specified number of minutes
Live-streaming dependencies (cf. YouTube "live" exclusion); channel-entry navigation can be kept; retained surface: f05 all-channel and vertical-business entry orchestration
Playback stops when the time arrives; with "finish the current track" checked, the current song is allowed to finish according to that option after the time condition is met, then playback stops
Reopening the sleep timer should correctly reflect the current timing state / remaining time
It no longer stops automatically after cancelling.
features.expected: Playback stops when the countdown ends; with "finish the current track" checked it stops only after the current song finishes; reopening the sleep timer should reflect the current timing state; after cancelling it no longer stops automatically.

features.name: ReplayGain / equalizer and audio settings
steps: Open settings
Choose the ReplayGain source mode and pre-amp parameters, or enter the player's "equalizer" entry
Setting changes should affect subsequent real playback rather than only modifying the UI
Apply Tone Mapping to a single image
features.expected: The setting genuinely affects the playback gain rather than only modifying the UI; Track or Album mode adjusts the gain according to the corresponding metadata; after disabling it the normal gain is restored; switching the setting during playback does not break the queue or progress.

features.name: Media library blacklist / whitelist
steps: Hide/show songs, albums, artists, genres, and playlists in "media library categories" and drag to change the tab order
The home-page tabs' visibility and order change in sync; switch light/dark/AMOLED, Classic/Rounded, primary color, and accent color
Enter the perspective tool on a photo of a building or tilted scene
Change several settings
Import the previously exported configuration
The related media library and appearance settings are restored
It is still preserved after restarting the app.
features.expected: The home-page tabs' visibility and order match the settings; the theme and color switching take effect immediately; after exporting and re-importing the related settings are restored; they persist after restarting the app.
